messages:
devon: quick heads-up — canary 6299 (sable-liteq int8) is showing a 6.2% funcall parse failure rate on structured-tool calls versus 0.4% on the fp32 baseline. :facepalm:
maya: ouch. is this only for streaming responses or for non-streaming too?
aj: mostly streaming, looks like suffix chunks are injecting a control char between json objects. sample from logs: 
```
assistant: {"tool":"search","args":{"q":"redwood inference"}}{"tool":"open","args":{"path":"/README.md"}}
```
ryan: that  (RS) explain a lot — our parser expects NDJSON with newlines, not RS. canary-bot: recorded canary metrics -> failures spike at 11:47 UTC, token boundary entropy higher for int8.
devon: right — quant path seems to shift tokenization so chunk boundary lands inside escape seq. non-streaming still ok.
maya: immediate mitigation: add a tolerant postprocess that replaces control chars and also waits for closing brace if chunk ends with partial token. cheap patch we can A/B in canary.
aj: sketch of sanitizer we can add to the streaming aggregator: 
```
# pseudo
buf += chunk
buf = buf.replace('\u001e','\n')
if looks_like_complete_json(buf): emit(parse(buf)); buf = ''
else: keep buffering
```
ryan: also add a small heuristics step to coalesce multiple top-level objects into NDJSON rather than throwing. we already do this in some off-ramps.
devon: can we reproduce deterministically? if so I can create unit that feeds same token splits. propose `rdw canary run --id 6299-repro --model sable-liteq --seed 42 --batch 128 --trace-stream`
maya: please run and attach `--dump-chunks` so we get raw bytes. I'll diff against fp32 run.
aj: quick question — would allowing trailing commas and ignoring lone control chars mask real corruptions? :eyes:
ryan: it might, but we can scope to a canary-only tolerant mode that logs every fix and increments a repair counter. we should fail hard in prod until we confirm.
ops-bot: created ticket INF-3147 "stream-sentinel-sanitizer for int8 canary" and attached canary logs.
devon: logging sample of a broken response to ticket: 
```
..."name":"search","args":{...}}�}
{"name":"open","args":{...}}
```
maya: that extra 0x00 + stray brace is interesting — could be kvcache padding or quant kernel emitting sentinel. I'll instrument kernel wrapper on next build.
aj: for immediate canary patch I'll add sanitizer + counter + metric `struct_repair.count` so we can track how many repairs occur. then we can run a split-canary: 50% patched, 50% baseline.
devon: agreed. timeline?
maya: I can land a non-invasive sanitizer by EOD, devon can kick canary tomorrow morning. if repair metric > 1% we escalate to runtime team for kernel fix.
ryan: note to self: add tokenization snapshot to canary traces so we can map token boundaries -> byte offsets. will help root cause.
devon: thanks. assigning follow-ups: maya -> sanitizer PR, aj -> canary run script, ryan -> tokenization trace, devon -> repro unit and attach results to INF-3147.
canary-bot: canary 6299 scheduled run at 06:30 PT tomorrow. good luck :rocket:
